summary: Automatic Data Processing Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into two new credit facilities: a $5.7 billion 364-day facility and a $3.5 billion five-year revolving facility, replacing prior facilities. JPMorgan Chase is Administrative Agent. The facilities provide revolving credit in USD, CAD, and EUR with floating rates based on Term SOFR or base rate plus a margin, and commitment fees on unused amounts. This is a routine refinancing of bank credit lines, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special event is described.
